resources.string: Camera is off — no problem. Pick a photo from the gallery, or type the items in.
Couldn\'t read anything useful. Try more light, hold steadier, and get closer — or type the items in.
Reading took too long and was stopped. Try again, or type the items in.
Only Latin-script receipts are supported for now.
Nothing is added until you confirm it. Fix anything that\'s wrong.
Adds up: the items match the printed total
Adds up: items plus tax and tip match the printed total
Doesn\'t add up — the items differ from the printed total. Fix an amount or the total.
Doesn\'t add up — items plus tax and tip differ from the printed total. Fix an amount or the total.
Only the total was readable. You can add the items by hand, or keep it as one amount.
Some lines couldn\'t be read and were left out — check the paper.
